---
title: "Getting Started"
description: "Create and run a small GRETL next job."
---

Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Create a Gradle project, apply the plugin and register your first task.

```groovy
plugins {
    id 'ch.so.agi.gretl'
}

import ch.so.agi.gretl.tasks.SqlExecutor

tasks.register('executeSql', SqlExecutor) {
    database 'jdbc:sqlite:build/example.db'
    sqlFiles 'sql/init.sql'
}
```

Run the task:

```bash
./gradlew executeSql
```
